A family room, a formal dining room, a theater room, four bedrooms and five bathrooms are also within the 6,755 square feet of living space.

The property was listed in October 2020 for $5.995 million and features a two-story foyer, high-ceilinged living room, family room, formal dining room, theater room, four bedrooms, and five bathrooms. The kitchen boasts two refrigerators, a 10-burner stove, and three warming drawers while the breakfast room includes a wine fridge. The outdoor amenities include a swimming pool, spa, barbecue area, and sports court. The property also has a three-car garage. Kaufman, who managed the careers of Aerosmith, Eagles, and Stevie Nicks, purchased the property in 2001 for $2.75 million. His daughter, Brooke Kaufman of Hilton & Hyland, is the listing agent.
